def: Combining data, tensor and pipeline parallelism in one training run; adding context or expert parallelism gives what practitioners call 4D or 5D parallelism.
practice: Tensor parallelism stays inside a fast NVLink domain, pipeline stages span nodes and data parallelism replicates the arrangement; Megatron-LM's combination reached 52% of theoretical peak on 3,072 GPUs (Narayanan et al., 2021).
